Title: Lutz von Hohenzollern ousted by a referendum

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Someone on IRC wrote:
> If Lutz von Hohenzollern's controller's prey had 1 pool and
> someone else's vampire calls a referendum that passes and ousts
> Lutz's controller, would the prey be ousted as well?

Lutz's effect is applied after the referendum is resolved (like Armin Brenner,
Donal Cargill, Guru, and Treachery).

If Lutz is in play to trigger the effect, the effect will happen, even if he is
no longer in play when the effect is to be applied.

Like an NRA PAC that leaves play:
http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/6c447cf89251ec8c

--

P.S. And, as long as we're listing effects, note that Poison Pill's effect is
stuffed into the referendum's resolution (by card text), rather than being held
until after resolution.

Lutz's predator gets 1 VP for ousting Lutz' controller (during referendum
resoltuion). Then she gets 1 VP for ousting her new prey (Lutz's controller's
prey) after referendum resolution.
